source.title: A Just Reward
source.description: You've done much to defend our brood, <class>. It seems fitting that we repay you with a gift that you may use to continue to defend others. Speak with me when you are ready and we'll destroy this false Dragon Soul together. I believe that I can harness some of the energy released as the simulacrum's magic dissipates along with a bit of my own magic to create something special for you.
source.objective: Speak with Krasus to destroy the Simulacrum of the Dragon Soul and receive your reward.
source.completion:
I can't say I've ever used magic to craft a shield before but the results are rather impressive, if I could be so vainglorious as to say so myself.

With this, our business is concluded and I must be on my way. Use this well in the defense of those most in need of your protection.

Farewell, mortal.
